title: Schedule a post
content:
# Schedule a post

Write a post in the Zernio dashboard, pick the accounts, attach a photo or video and schedule it for later.

import { Step, Steps } from 'fumadocs-ui/components/steps';

Your assistant can schedule posts for you, and you can always do it yourself in the dashboard. This example schedules a YouTube video.

## Write and schedule a post

<Steps>
<Step>

**Open the composer**

In the [dashboard](https://zernio.com/dashboard/posts-all), go to **Posts** and click **Create post**.

<StepVideo src="/videos/for-you/post-1-create.mp4" caption="Opening Create Post" />

</Step>
<Step>

**Pick the accounts**

Under **platforms**, tick every account the post goes to. Narrow the list with **choose profiles** or the search box when you have many.

<StepVideo src="/videos/for-you/post-2-account.mp4" caption="Selecting a YouTube channel" />

</Step>
<Step>

**Write it and add media**

Type the text, then click **Add media** to attach photos or a video from your computer.

<StepVideo src="/videos/for-you/post-3-content.mp4" caption="Writing the description and attaching a video" />

</Step>
<Step>

**Fill in the platform's fields**

Each platform you picked adds its own section. YouTube asks for a **title** and a **privacy status**.

<StepVideo src="/videos/for-you/post-4-youtube.mp4" caption="Adding a YouTube title and making the video private" />

</Step>
<Step>

**Choose when it goes out**

Under **publishing**, keep **Schedule**, pick the **date & time** and check the **timezone**. Click **schedule post**.

<StepVideo src="/videos/for-you/post-5-schedule.mp4" caption="Scheduling the post" />

![The composer with the account, title, privacy and date filled in](/docs-static/schedule-post/composer-filled.png)

</Step>
</Steps>

The other publishing options: **Now** posts right away, **Queue** takes the next free slot of your posting schedule, and **Draft** saves it without a date.

## Find your scheduled posts

The post shows in **Posts** as **scheduled**. Switch between the grid, table and calendar views at the top right.

<StepVideo src="/videos/for-you/post-6-views.mp4" caption="Switching between the table and calendar views" />

![A scheduled post in the January calendar](/docs-static/schedule-post/calendar.png)

Click a post to edit or reschedule it before it goes out.

## Next steps

- [Connect an account](/for-you/connect-account): add more accounts to post to.
- [Post images and videos](/for-you/media): get a file from your computer into a post through your assistant.
- [Things to ask](/for-you/prompts): have your assistant schedule posts for you.
